brief: Slice E FR-017/017a/018/019 outcome-based media downgrade and classifier codes

evidence: Baseline confirmed at slice F tip 2c97b0bb: pkg/agent/{translate_error,media_downgrade,runturn_redo_test,turn}.go unchanged. TryMediaDowngrade gated only on CodeMediaUnsupported (media_downgrade.go:54-57); per-turn guards ts.mediaRetryDone/ts.imageRetryDone (turn.go:252,259). LLMError codes enum has 7 entries (translate_error.go:30-58); userMessages + isRetryable map only those 7. Loop wires retry on success at 6915-6928 but never relabels. Three hypotheses explored against the spec (lines 179,478-484,1080-1083,1173) and ADR §4 (lines 65,79,141,163) plus plan §7.6 (line 221): H1 (rejected) — only extend body-substrings within existing classifyByHTTPStatus; would not deliver outcome-based fallback as a distinct gate because the classifier already routes 4xx+empty body to CodeProviderRejected, not CodeUnknown. H2 (accepted) — extend TryMediaDowngrade so classifier-primary OR (CodeUnknown AND status∈4xx AND media present AND status not in {401,403,413,auth context-overflow,content-policy,tool-args,schema}) fires step 4; classifier body-substrings add CodeToolArgs/CodeSchema to make the exclusion set closed. H3 (rejected) — implement outcome-based fallback purely from status code without new body-substring codes; spec FR-018 explicitly requires the two new codes so the exclusion set is closed against 4xx variants with unrecognised phrasing; FR-017a requires relabel on success. Slice F territory (pkg/agent/loop_media.go) is off-limits; loop.go rewiring is permitted at the retry-success branch only. Reproduction: current scoped tests pass (CGO_ENABLED=0 go test -tags goolm,stdjson -count=1 -run '^(TestStep4|TestClassifier|TestTryMediaDowngrade)' -p 1 ./pkg/agent/ -> ok 0.020s; the gap is that no test exercises the CodeUnknown-inconclusive retry path or the new exclusion codes.

Added NEW test file pkg/agent/media_outcome_retry_test.go (Wave-1 prompt rule respected: no existing test bodies in loop_media_test.go / loop_test.go / loop_media_normalization_test.go / runturn_redo_test.go were touched). 12 new test funcs cover the named TDD rows: TestStep4_OutcomeRelabel_OnSuccessfulRetry (FR-017a success), TestStep4_RetryFailsWithDifferentError_NotForceRelabeled (FR-017a R2-m1 failure), TestClassifier_CodeToolArgs (FR-018 body-substring), TestClassifier_CodeSchema (FR-018 body-substring), TestClassifier_StatusBackstop_ToolArgsVia403 (FR-018 status wins), TestStep4_PerClassGuardsPreserved (FR-019 PDF/image independence incl. mixed media), TestStep4_ExclusionSet_SuppressesFallback (FR-017 exclusion set closed), TestStep4_NoMedia_OutcomeFallbackSkipped (media-present precondition), TestStep4_NilTurnStateIsSafe (new branch nil-safety), TestStep4_ClassifierPrimaryPathUnchanged (back-compat invariant), TestStep4_ClassifierSubstringFalsePositive_AvoidsRelabel, TestStep4_RelabelOnSuccess_ViaLoopCallSite (loop call-site wiring). Red observed: 'undefined: CodeToolArgs' and 'undefined: CodeSchema' build failure on focused run; no other test changes; pre-existing tests in pkg/agent still pass (would-be green unchanged set was not invoked because the package fails to build, which is the correct red state).

Implemented CodeToolArgs + CodeSchema (translate_error.go): two new LLMErrorCode constants, two substring helpers (isToolArgsMessage / isSchemaMessage), substring detection added to classifyByHTTPStatus's 4xx branch and classifyByMessage's fallback path, and userMessages entries for both (retryable=false). Status-code backstop preserved: 401/403/413 routes to CodeProviderRejected BEFORE body substring check. Extended TryMediaDowngrade (media_downgrade.go) with shared applyMediaDowngrade method preserving per-class guards (mediaRetryDone for PDF, imageRetryDone for image) and a new outcomeFallbackEligible gate + callMessagesCarryMedia precondition. Gate accepts classifier CodeUnknown OR (CodeProviderRejected AND status in 4xx AND status ∉ {401,403,413}) AND none of the exclusion substrings (context-overflow / content-policy / bad-tool-args / schema) match the body — matches spec BDD row 1013 (Gemini 400 'Unsupported MIME type: image/svg+xml'). Failure-edge double-check on exclusion substrings closes any regression where classifyByHTTPStatus returns CodeProviderRejected for a 4xx whose body matches one of the new codes. Added turnState.outcomeRelabel + setOutcomeRelabel + outcomeRelabelCode methods (turn.go). Wired loop.go success branch: when the helper fires and callLLM returns nil AND the helper's verdict was NOT CodeMediaUnsupported, stamp ts.outcomeRelabel = CodeMediaUnsupported — FR-017a success edge. Classifier-primary path's verdict is already CodeMediaUnsupported so no relabel needed there (no force-relabel on a primary-path failure). Pre-existing TestEncodeImageToDataURL_NonDecodableReturnsEmpty still fails on parent commit 2c97b0bb WITHOUT my changes (verified via git stash round-trip) — Wave 3 T9 owns that rewrite per the Wave-1 prompt rule.
